children: Plans by French utility EDF to sell a stake in Italian energy group Edison
are currently on hold because uncertainty over developments in the Gulf region is clouding the outlook on gas supplies, Edison CEO Nicola Monti said on Friday.

"As far as I know, the shareholder's willingness to pursue the capital-opening project remains intact. At this point we will see when the process resumes," Monti said at the Ambrosetti business forum in Cernobbio, on Lake Como.
Separately, Monti said Edison remained in the running to acquire Bioenerys, Snam's biomethane unit, and expected to submit a binding offer by the end of this month.

According to Italian daily Il Sole 24 Ore, three bidders remain in contention for the asset, valued at between €400 million and €500 million: Edison, infrastructure fund F2i and renewable gas company Retina.
